scope: Public advertised allowances, not configured-account balances or measured OCR throughput

providers.name: Tesseract
providers.note: No provider credit meter when run locally; hardware, electricity and gateway limits still apply.

providers.name: LlamaParse
providers.note: Free-plan credits allocated entirely to Fast basic OCR, without add-ons or other platform usage; richer tiers cost more.

providers.name: Mistral OCR
providers.note: Free mode has organization-specific included usage and OCR limits. Current live sources do not establish a universal fixed credit/page grant; excluded, not counted as zero. Cached $10/month search snippets were not used.

providers.name: OCR.space
providers.note: Apply both monthly and daily caps. One page/request for the baseline; three-page PDFs fitting the file limit only in the packed-PDF scenario.

providers.name: Azure Document Intelligence
providers.note: Requires an eligible Free F0 resource; F0 processes at most two pages/request. Paid-resource usage is not free just because F0 exists.

providers.name: Google Document AI
providers.note: Only the advertised standard Document OCR free band is counted. Other processors/add-ons differ; no separate Cloud Vision allowance is added. Detailed pricing and the OCR overview support this figure; the generic product summary omits the free band.

providers.name: Amazon Textract
providers.note: New-customer trial only. Text OCR is counted separately from the recurring total; Forms/Tables/Layout allowance is not stacked onto the basic-text scenario. S3/other service charges can apply.

providers.name: PaddleOCR
providers.note: Self-hosted software has no provider page-credit meter; compute/hosting and service limits apply.

providers.name: Docling
providers.note: Self-hosted software has no provider page-credit meter; compute/hosting and service limits apply.

providers.name: Custom OCR endpoint
providers.note: Depends on the configured service. The adapter itself supplies no independent credits and cannot be assumed free.

assumptions: One eligible account/organization per provider, no key/account/IP multiplication, all relevant included usage unspent and allocated to OCR.
Planning ceilings, not throughput, live balances, billing guarantees or a fungible pooled credit balance. Provider reset dates can differ.
No retries, duplicate processing, add-ons or failed/uncertain submissions consuming allowance. Other account usage reduces capacity.
Recurring baseline uses one page per OCR.space request; the packed-PDF ceiling assumes every OCR.space request contains three pages within 1 MB.
Promotional dollar credits, storage, compute costs, unquantified Mistral usage, custom services and local engine capacity are excluded from page sums.
